name: comp-277
title: Error List Alert
blurb: Error alert with bulleted list of issues.
description: Error alert that displays multiple error messages as a bulleted list. Useful for form validation showing all failures at once.
use_when: Form validation with multiple errors that need to be listed and addressed by the user.
avoid_when: Single errors. When space is constrained or error count is very high (10+).
a11y: List structure provides semantic meaning. No ARIA alert role. Parent should add role='alert' and aria-live for screen reader announcements.
